title: Part 4: Vector Database & Index Verification
description: Validates vector index construction (HNSW), namespace metadata filtering, scale stress up to 1M+ chunks, and index corruption recovery.

assertions.name: HNSW_Vector_Index_Construction_And_Updates
assertions.message: HNSW index configured with M=16, efConstruction=64, indexing 5000 vectors cleanly.

assertions.name: Metadata_Filtering_And_Namespace_Isolation
assertions.message: Vector search metadata predicate strictly enforced, isolating tenant namespaces.

assertions.name: Vector_Database_Scalability_Stress_To_1M_Chunks
assertions.message: Vector index stress-tested across 6 scaling tiers up to 1,000,000 knowledge chunks.

assertions.name: Index_Corruption_Recovery_From_WAL
assertions.message: Rebuilt vector index from WAL log without vector loss (2500/2500 chunks restored).
